Aircraft.name: Jet Attacker - Stormvark
Aircraft.Instructions:
Stormvark By: Shizzle Styx
AG1: Opens Canopy AG2: Opens/activates internal weapons bay AG3: Deploys arrester Hook AG4: Within Visual Range Combat mode AG8: Enables manual/automatic wing control (default Automatic). Paired with VTOL slider for manual control.
Flaps: Deploys flaps at negative %s VTOL: Manual wing sweep control Trim: Trims aircraft pitch controls
Notes: Super Wasp brings the agility and style. Stormvark brings the brute force range, payload - Basically the fighter equivalent of a freight train that treats finesse as a suggestion. Inspireded by the F-111B and it's fleet defence brief which traded dogfighting for: "Go far, go fast and carry a worryingly large number of explody things". A capable and misunderstood jet eclipsed by shifting Navy priorities and the age of the Tomcat. Perhaps ironically, the Stormvark is the perfect compliment to the Super Wasp: Beauty and the Beast... if the Beast was an air to air sledge hammer with afterburners and a bomb bay.
